entities.name: Quantitative Data in Historical Research
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The use of numerical data — census records, economic statistics, demographic measurements, and computational analysis — to study historical patterns. From the Domesday Book to modern cliometrics and big data approaches, quantitative methods have transformed history from purely narrative to analytically rigorous, revealing patterns invisible to traditional scholarship.
